name: principle
description: A principle or design preference of SRS, stated as a claim with its mechanism.

aiGuidance.purpose: Use for charter principles, held pairs and this-over-that preferences. Quote the charter faithfully where it exists. Keep the claim to one sentence and the explanation to the mechanism that enforces it. AI never decides or ratifies: say so wherever authority is in question. A principle that is a held pair also names its two sides in pole_a and pole_b, set together, and leaves them empty otherwise.
